preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 and x <= 2**31 for x in [a, b, c])
preconditions.description: Input values a, b, c are non-negative integers within bounds 0 ≤ a, b, c ≤ 2³¹.
At least one of a, b, c is greater than zero.

postconditions.description: Output is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer (minimum fights required).

postconditions.expression: (a == 0 and b == 0) or (a == 0 and c == 0) or (b == 0 and c == 0) or (a + b + c == 1) or (a + b + c == 2 and (a == 2 or b == 2 or c == 2))
postconditions.description: If the total number of pixels is 1 or 2, or if two colors are already zero, the output is 0 (already peaceful).
If the total number of pixels is divisible by 3, it is possible to make all pixels the same color; otherwise, output is -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1' if (a + b + c == 3) else (stdout == '3' if (a + b + c == 4 and (a == 3 or b == 3 or c == 3)) else True)
postconditions.description: For specific edge cases (total pixels 3 or 4 with one color having 3 pixels), the output matches the given examples.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == (a + b + c) - max(a, b, c) if (a + b + c) % 3 == 0 else False
postconditions.description: If possible, the minimum number of fights is the total pixels minus the maximum count of any single color.
